title: NIST WebBook: Acetylene is C2H2, molecular weight 26.0373 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Acetylene as C2H2, molecular weight 26.0373 amu, CAS 74-86-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Acetylene, CAS Registry Number 74-86-2, lists molecular formula C2H2 and molecular weight 26.0373 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 26.0156501 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C2H2/c1-2/h1-2H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
